blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. blocks.text: Mountain Meadows Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is detached houses along Noons Creek Drive and its terraces — Falcon Drive, Thurston Terrace, Maude Court, Barberry Place, Shale Court and Sandstone Crescent — the street set the 184 bus serves.

Chapter 14 of Port Moody 2050 sets this group's future vision as small-scale, multi-unit housing (SSMUH) gentle densification along existing lot patterns, so the house lots themselves are the densification surface here.

blocks.text: Mountain Meadows Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Port Moody 2050, the City's Official Community Plan, was adopted by Council on April 28, 2026, and its Chapter 14 vision for this five-neighbourhood group is SSMUH gentle densification along existing lot patterns.
The RS1-S small-lot rezoning route is not offered in Mountain Meadows: the City's list is Moody Centre, Seaview and Pleasantside only.

blocks.text: Mountain Meadows Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The neighbourhood's street pattern is readable off a bus timetable: the 184's stop list on Noons Creek Drive is the fullest official trace of the pocket's terraces.
The City does not plan Mountain Meadows alone: it is one of five neighbourhoods in a single Chapter 14 section, so Official Community Plan reading for this pocket is a five-neighbourhood section.
David Avenue, the top-edge street, is a through route to the Coquitlam side of the ridge, so the pocket has a second-city edge at its top.
Noons Creek Drive is the spine and David Avenue the top edge, with the 184 running the full stop list on the Drive before turning to Panorama Drive.
Heritage Mountain and Heritage Woods adjoin in the same Chapter 14 group, sharing the ridge's street system toward Coquitlam.

blocks.text: Mountain Meadows Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Confirm the lot's SSMUH options in the RS zone before assuming added units, since the plan vision is gentle densification along existing lot patterns, not rezoning.
Confirm the SD43 catchment for the exact address, since the recorded locator chain comes from a central Port Moody address, not a Noons Creek Drive one.
Expect sidewalk work disruption at 1309 and 1005 Noons Creek Drive while the City's listed repairs run.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Mountain Meadows?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 4 houses listed in Mountain Meadows. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Mountain Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Mountain Meadows had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Mountain Meadows from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 1 houses sold in Mountain Meadows over those 5 months, out of 64 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Mountain Meadows?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What densification applies to Mountain Meadows houses?
faq.a: Gentle densification along existing lot patterns: Chapter 14 of Port Moody 2050 gives this five-neighbourhood group — Heritage Mountain, Twin Creeks, Noons Creek, Mountain Meadows and Heritage Woods — a future vision of small-scale, multi-unit housing added along the existing lot pattern, rather than tower or project rezoning.

faq.q: Which elementary school is named for this side of the city?
faq.a: Mountain Meadows Elementary is the School District No. 43 (SD43) elementary school carrying this neighbourhood's name, and the recorded locator chain for a central Port Moody address runs Mountain Meadows Elementary, Scott Creek Middle and Gleneagle Secondary; SD43 assigns catchments by address, so confirm the chain for a specific Noons Creek Drive address with the district.

faq.q: Is there a small-lot split option here?
faq.a: No: the RS1-S small-lot rezoning is offered only in Moody Centre, Seaview and Pleasantside, and Mountain Meadows is not on the City's list, so added units here come through small-scale multi-unit housing in the RS zones instead.
